builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Illaoi: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (2,536 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 57.3% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A territorial melee fighter who prepares tentacles and spirits, then punishes opponents who remain near her ultimate. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Black Cleaver → Iceborn Gauntlet → Sterak's Gage. Grasp of the Undying keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Spirit Visage, Unending Despair.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Black Cleaver → Iceborn Gauntlet → Sterak's Gage, with Grasp of the Undying.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Black Cleaver → Iceborn Gauntlet → Sterak's Gage) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 57.3% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Black Cleaver → Iceborn Gauntlet → Sterak's Gage.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

kitEvidence.formula:
Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for [7] seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with [0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0008) × AD] of that damage echoing to its owner.

If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for [4] seconds and is Slowed by [80]% for [1.5] seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible.

Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=4, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Passive: Slam damage is increased by @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageAmp*100@% (currently @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage).

Active: Illaoi swings her idol, causing a Tentacle to Slam forward.

Illaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby ([characterLevelInterpolation(18 → 7; raw flags preserved)] second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's Abilities.

Slam deals @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage. Hitting at least one enemy champion restores [5]% missing Health to Illaoi.

Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional [(3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5 + (0.035) × AD) × (0.01)] max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target.

Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit.

For the next [8] seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a @spell.IllaoiW:CooldownDuringR@ second cooldown.

builds.name: Spirit transfer health bruiser
builds.summary: Turn health investment into real spirit-transfer pressure.
builds.goal: Turn health investment into real spirit-transfer pressure.
builds.hypothesis: Test of Spirit echoes a fraction of spirit damage with a 0.0008 AD expression; Harsh Lesson has AD-linked percent-health physical damage and directs nearby tentacle slams. Bloodmail converts health to AD, Cleaver supports physical hits, and Visage enhances tentacle missing-health heals. Sundered Sky is reserved for Illaoi's actual attack, with spirit classification deliberately unproved.
testPlan: Required state: Need E connected, usable terrain tentacles and enemies remaining near the spirit.
Compare owner health lost with spirit-only damage versus owner-plus-spirit overlap, logging individual hits.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Kiting or destroying tentacles denies the loop; spirit transfer cannot replace direct target access forever.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Spirit damage and echoed damage are not automatically two independent item procs against the owner.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Illaoi: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A territorial melee fighter who prepares tentacles and spirits, then punishes opponents who remain near her ultimate. Fix tentacle/Spirit setup and actual nearby targets. Compare a prepared territory with an unprepared chase; transfer damage and repeated tentacle heals must not be double-counted. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Illaoi: Fix tentacle/Spirit setup and actual nearby targets. Compare a prepared territory with an unprepared chase; transfer damage and repeated tentacle heals must not be double-counted.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Increases the damage dealt by Tentacles. When activated, Illaoi smashes down a Tentacle that deals physical damage. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Illaoi's stated kit question: Fix tentacle/Spirit setup and actual nearby targets. Compare a prepared territory with an unprepared chase; transfer damage and repeated tentacle heals must not be double-counted.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Ultimate lesson clock
builds.summary: Test more attack-and-slam cycles inside Leap of Faith.
builds.goal: Test more attack-and-slam cycles inside Leap of Faith.
builds.hypothesis: Leap of Faith grants an eight-second window where tentacles slam 50% faster and W cooldown changes. Trinity adds one physical Spellblade to a real W attack; Blade rewards direct attacks and Shojin raises ability/passive damage after qualifying hits. The aim is repeated directed slams rather than expecting attack speed to make tentacles independently attack faster.
testPlan: Required state: Need R hitting multiple champions, tentacles placed and W targets in range.
Count W casts and actual tentacle slams within eight seconds at identical terrain placement.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Enemies disengage during R, or mana runs out; offensive purchases expose Illaoi before setup.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Attack speed does not directly reduce the tentacles' autonomous spirit/marked-target timer.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Blade of The Ruined King, Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
